description: 1. Agent reads all session transcripts from logs/raw/ and the existing memory/2025-01-10.md and memory/2025-01-22.md files. 2. Agent creates memory/2025-02-05.md and memory/2025-03-15.md with correctly classified entries (FACT/PREFERENCE/GOAL/BOUNDARY/HYPOTHESIS tags, timestamped, with impact scores). 3. Agent applies the integrity rule: inferred items like 'async/await preference' and 'pair-programming style' remain HYPOTHESIS and cannot be promoted to MEMORY.md without confirmation. 4. Agent applies confidence decay: the async/await HYPOTHESIS from 2025-01-10 (64 days old) must be discarded (Low→Discard after 60 days); the pair-programming HYPOTHESIS from 2025-01-22 (52 days old) must be demoted to Low confidence or discarded. 5. Agent writes MEMORY.md with: Python preference (repeated 3 sessions), short/direct answers preference (2 sessions), pytest preference (explicit, impact 2), company name BOUNDARY (explicit, impact 3 → immediate promotion), fast-decision style preference, dark mode PREFERENCE (explicitly confirmed), Project Helix as active GOAL (impact 3 → immediate promotion). 6. Agent does NOT include Rust (user requested forget), does NOT include Lodestar v1 Q1 2025 goal as active (project paused/demoted), does NOT promote either unconfirmed HYPOTHESIS to MEMORY.md.
